title: Enhancing Chat Language Models by Scaling High-quality Instructional Conversations
authors_zh: Ning Ding, Yulin Chen, Bokai Xu, Yujia Qin, Zhi Zheng, Shengding Hu, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun, Bowen Zhou
paper_type_zh: 合成多轮对话数据构造
best_for_zh: 适合生成或审计大规模多轮聊天 SFT 语料的研究者。
one_line: UltraChat generates both sides of 1.47M topic-steered conversations, turning explicit user-demand sectors into multi-turn SFT data.
UltraChat 同时生成 147 万段主题引导对话的双方发言，把明确的用户需求类别转成多轮 SFT 数据。
why: It makes synthetic user-turn provenance and conversational context visible in a large chat-training corpus.
inclusion_reason: UltraChat scales synthetic multi-turn instructional conversations to 1.5 million dialogues with an explicit topic and generation framework.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Human-written multi-turn instruction conversations are expensive and small, while single-turn instruction sets do not teach a chat model to maintain context across an exchange. Existing synthetic datasets also often leave the origin of user turns and topic coverage unclear.

UltraChat replaces manual dialogue writing with a structured synthetic pipeline: define three sectors of user needs, create topic or task metadata for each sector, generate both user and assistant turns with an OpenAI dialogue model, and train UltraLLaMA on the resulting conversations. It releases 1,468,352 English dialogues whose retained context supports multi-turn SFT.

L4 facts: primary source https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.14233; arXiv technical report, 2023; boundary: synthetic post-training conversations, not pretraining; atlas value: explicit prompt-source-to-dialogue lineage; data object: topic-steered multi-turn user/assistant records; evaluation surface: corpus statistics and model-based chat evaluation.

人工编写多轮指令对话成本高、规模小，而单轮指令数据无法教会聊天模型在多次交互中保持上下文。已有合成数据还常常没有说明用户轮从何而来，也没有清楚界定主题覆盖范围。

UltraChat 用结构化合成流程替代人工对话写作：先定义三类用户需求，为每类需求建立主题或任务元数据，再用 OpenAI 对话模型同时生成用户轮和助手轮，最后用所得对话训练 UltraLLaMA。论文发布了 1,468,352 段保留上下文的英文对话，可用于多轮 SFT。

L4 事实：主要来源为 https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.14233；2023 年 arXiv 技术报告；边界是合成后训练对话，而非预训练；图谱价值是明确展示从提示来源到对话的来源链；数据对象是主题引导的多轮用户—助手记录；评测包括语料统计和基于模型的聊天评估。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
UltraChat's main contribution is to scale synthetic conversation construction by separating user demand into Questions about the World, Creation and Writing, and Assistance on Existing Materials, then generating contextual exchanges for each sector. Unlike evolved single instructions such as WizardLM, its supervised object is a complete multi-turn conversation in which both sides are model-written. The teacher supplies targets rather than independent correctness feedback, so quality rests on construction controls, corpus analysis, and downstream evaluation.

Google Scholar citations: 952（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Enhancing+Chat+Language+Models+by+Scaling+High-quality+Instructional+Conversations&author=Ning+Ding&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. UltraChat, https://github.com/thunlp/UltraChat, contains 1,468,352 English dialogues averaging 3.8 turns and 1467.4 tokens per dialogue. Records are multi-turn user/assistant message sequences grouped by sector and distributed as downloadable JSON files for chat SFT; the paper does not establish factual labels or a per-record verifier, and users must check the repository's current release terms before redistribution.

UltraChat 的主要贡献是把用户需求拆成世界知识问答、创作与写作、基于现有材料的协助三类，再为每一类生成带上下文的交互，从而扩展合成对话构造。与 WizardLM 这类演化单条指令的方法不同，它的监督对象是双方均由模型生成的完整多轮对话。教师模型提供训练目标，而不是独立的正确性反馈，因此质量依据来自构造控制、语料分析和下游评测。

Google Scholar 引用数：952（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=Enhancing+Chat+Language+Models+by+Scaling+High-quality+Instructional+Conversations&author=Ning+Ding&hl=en）

开源数据：有。UltraChat 位于 https://github.com/thunlp/UltraChat，包含 1,468,352 段英文对话，平均每段 3.8 轮、1467.4 个 token。记录按三类需求组织，是用户与助手消息构成的多轮序列，并以可下载 JSON 文件发布，可用于聊天模型 SFT；论文没有提供事实标签或逐条验证器，再分发前需核对仓库当前的发布条款。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Define sectors. Input: intended chat use cases. Operation: divide them into world questions, creation/writing, and assistance on existing materials. Output: three construction branches. Check: each branch needs its own topic or task source rather than one generic seed pool.
  1. Create user-side metadata. Input: sector-specific resources such as topics, writing tasks, and existing text. Operation: sample and transform them into prompts that define a conversation goal. Output: a topic/task record for each planned dialogue. Check: retain the sector and source metadata for later coverage audits.
  1. Generate conversations. Input: the goal record, accumulated dialogue context, and an OpenAI dialogue model. Operation: iteratively generate a user query and assistant response while carrying prior turns forward. Output: an English multi-turn message sequence. Check: stop according to the sector prompt and reject malformed or disconnected exchanges.
  1. Assemble and analyze. Input: generated conversations. Operation: normalize records, collect 1,468,352 dialogues, and measure turns, length, diversity, and coherence. Output: the UltraChat JSON corpus. Check: statistics detect gross defects but do not verify factual correctness.
  1. Train and evaluate. Input: LLaMA and the UltraChat corpus. Operation: supervised fine-tune UltraLLaMA and compare chat responses with baselines using human/model judgments. Output: a chat checkpoint and comparison scores. Check: pin teacher, corpus revision, prompts, decoding, and judge version before reproduction.

1. 定义需求类别。 输入是预期的聊天用途。作者将其拆成世界知识问答、创作与写作、基于现有材料的协助三类，产出三条构造分支。检查时要求每个分支都有自己的主题或任务来源，而不是共用一个泛化种子池。
  1. 建立用户侧元数据。 输入是主题、写作任务、已有文本等类别专用资源。将其采样并转换成定义对话目标的提示，为每段计划对话产出主题或任务记录。应保留类别和来源元数据，供后续覆盖审计。
  1. 生成对话。 输入是目标记录、已经累积的对话上下文和 OpenAI 对话模型。系统携带此前轮次，迭代生成用户问题与助手回答，产出英文多轮消息序列。按照各类别的提示终止，并拒绝格式错误或上下文断裂的交互。
  1. 汇总并分析。 输入是生成的对话。规范记录并汇总出 1,468,352 段对话，再统计轮数、长度、多样性和连贯性，产出 UltraChat JSON 语料。统计量只能发现明显缺陷，不能验证事实正确性。
  1. 训练并评测。 输入是 LLaMA 和 UltraChat 语料。通过监督微调得到 UltraLLaMA，再用人工或模型判断与基线比较，产出聊天 checkpoint 和比较分数。复现前需固定教师模型、语料版本、提示、解码和评判模型版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Corpus scale and structure (Table 1). UltraChat contains 1,468,352 dialogues with 3.8 average turns and 1467.4 average tokens per dialogue, far larger and longer than the compared public chat corpora. This verifies construction scale and retained context, not correctness, safety, or real-user coverage.

Chat-model comparison (Table 7). Under the paper's automatic chat evaluation, UltraLLaMA scores 9.023 ± 0.952 and Vicuna scores 8.961 ± 0.718. Both are LLaMA-based chat models, but their training corpora and recipes differ, so the small gap supports the usability of the full UltraChat training setup rather than isolating the synthetic corpus as the sole cause.

语料规模与结构（表 1）。 UltraChat 包含 1,468,352 段对话，平均 3.8 轮、每段 1467.4 个 token，规模和长度都明显超过论文比较的公开聊天语料。这证明了构造规模和上下文保留情况，不能证明正确性、安全性或真实用户覆盖。

聊天模型比较（表 7）。 在论文的自动聊天评测中，UltraLLaMA 得分为 9.023 ± 0.952，Vicuna 为 8.961 ± 0.718。两者都以 LLaMA 为基础，但训练语料和配方不同，因此这个较小差距只能支持完整 UltraChat 训练方案可用，不能把收益单独归因于合成语料。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Single-turn instruction sets and smaller human chat corpora are the nearest baseline. UltraChat changes the construction object to a sector-conditioned multi-turn conversation, including synthetic user turns and retained context, and scales it to nearly 1.5 million dialogues. Teacher generation and SFT are not new; the contribution is the explicit topic/task-to-conversation pipeline and its corpus-scale implementation. It makes user-turn provenance and contextual consistency first-class data-audit targets.
最接近的基线是单轮指令数据和规模较小的人工聊天语料。UltraChat 把构造对象改成按需求类别生成的多轮对话，其中包含合成用户轮并保留上下文，再把规模扩展到接近 150 万段。教师生成和 SFT 并不是新方法；真正的贡献是明确的“主题或任务到对话”流程及其大规模实现。它也使用户轮来源和上下文一致性成为一等数据审计对象。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Shared teacher bias. The OpenAI dialogue model writes both speakers, so its factual errors, style, and assumptions can compound across turns; sample complete conversations with an independent factual/safety check.
  • Coverage gap. Topic diversity statistics do not establish coverage of real user traffic, and the released corpus is English-only; compare sectors and languages against the deployment distribution.
  • Evaluation ambiguity. UltraLLaMA and Vicuna differ in training data and recipe, while model-based chat scores are judge-sensitive; rerun matched checkpoints with a pinned judge before attributing gains.

• 教师偏差共用。 OpenAI 对话模型同时编写双方发言，其事实错误、表达风格和隐含假设可能跨轮累积；应抽查完整对话，并加入独立的事实与安全检查。
  • 覆盖缺口。 主题多样性统计不能证明覆盖真实用户流量，而且发布语料仅支持英文；需把类别和语言分布与实际部署需求比较。
  • 评测归因不清。 UltraLLaMA 和 Vicuna 的训练数据与配方不同，模型评判分数也依赖评判者；归因前应固定评判模型并用匹配 checkpoint 重跑。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use UltraChat when building multi-turn SFT data without enough human conversations. Supply a target-use taxonomy, sector-specific topic/task sources, a pinned dialogue teacher, and quality filters; generate both sides while retaining context, then output versioned conversation JSON and coverage reports. Success means sampled dialogues remain coherent and useful across turns and improve a matched chat model. Do not use it unchanged for non-English users, high-stakes factual domains, or settings where synthetic user behavior poorly matches deployment traffic.
缺少人工多轮对话、但需要构造聊天 SFT 数据时，可以使用 UltraChat 的流程。输入目标用途分类、各类别的主题或任务来源、固定版本的对话教师和质量过滤器，同时生成双方发言并保留上下文，最终输出有版本记录的对话 JSON 和覆盖报告。成功标准是抽样对话跨轮仍然连贯有用，并能提升配置匹配的聊天模型。对于非英语用户、高风险事实领域，或合成用户行为与部署流量差异较大的场景，不应原样采用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Keep: UltraChat's key object is a complete synthetic conversation, including model-written user turns and context.
  2. Use when: multi-turn SFT data is scarce and the target traffic can be represented by explicit sectors.
  3. Record: sector, source topic/task, teacher version, every message, stopping reason, and filter decision.
  4. Do not infer: 1.47M dialogues or high diversity does not establish factual quality or real-user coverage.
  5. Audit first: sample full conversations, compare target-language coverage, and rerun evaluation with matched recipes.

1. 应记住： UltraChat 的关键对象是完整合成对话，其中包括模型生成的用户轮和上下文。
  2. 适用条件： 多轮 SFT 数据稀缺，而且目标流量可以用明确的需求类别表示。
  3. 必须记录： 类别、来源主题或任务、教师版本、所有消息、终止原因和过滤决定。
  4. 不能推出： 147 万段对话或较高多样性并不代表事实质量和真实用户覆盖。
  5. 扩展前审计： 抽查完整对话、比较目标语言覆盖，并用配置匹配的训练方案重跑评测。
